title: Quantized Howe-type dualities via Koornwinder polynomials and the X=K phenomenon
summary: We derive the equality between one-dimensional sums associated with tensor products of Kirillov-Reshetikhin column crystals of classical affine types and Lusztig q-analogues of weight multiplicities. The matching of the corresponding root systems is suggested by Howe duality. Our main tool is the dual Cauchy formula for Koornwinder polynomials due to Mimachi, which we combine with specializations in these polynomials.
